question: Under India's National Anaemia Control Programme, weekly supervised iron–folic acid supplementation is provided to adolescent girls aged 10–19 years as part of the Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS) scheme.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. WIFS is a key component of NACP targeting adolescents, providing weekly IFA supplementation (60 mg elemental iron + 500 µg folic acid) to reduce anaemia prevalence in the 10–19-year age group.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The WIFS scheme under NACP provides weekly IFA tablets (containing 60 mg elemental iron + 500 µg folic acid) to adolescent girls and boys in schools and out-of-school settings to address the high prevalence of anaemia in this age group.
